info.name: FraudDetection App API — proposed additions
info.description:
Requests the Fraud Analyst screens need that the FraudDetection App API collection doesn’t have yet, or needs to return more from.

＋ new request · ◐ change to an existing request (the example shows the proposed response).

Every example was produced by the web app’s mock layer, so it matches what the screens render today. Same conventions as the main collection: JSON, snake_case, money in minor units, ISO 8601 times, masked identifiers, Problem Details for errors.

Fixes to the existing collection
- Many requests carry a third example with no status code (the Problem body). The Postman mock serves it as HTTP 200 unless x-mock-response-code is sent. Give those examples a code (400/403/404) or remove them.
- POST /alerts/{id}/promote → the 201 example returns FD-3050 (the auto-case); it should be a new case id.
- POST /cases/{id}/resolution, /decision, /reopen → 200 examples return stage "prospect" / status "reopened"; use the real next state.
- POST /cases/{id}/monitor → days_left (9492) should equal days.
- Example numbers are generated noise in several places (risk_score 8934, progress_pct 8535.8, status 9548); keep them inside their ranges.
- GET /cases/{id}/evidence and the subscriber activity/devices examples are placeholder strings.
